item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem:
Meena notices that the iron gate at her school in Jaipur develops brown rust during the rainy season.

Iron rusts only when it is in contact with ……1…… .

Rusting of the gate can be prevented by ……2…… its surface with paint or oil.

Which words correctly complete gaps 1 and 2?

options.A: 1 both air and water; 2 leaving uncovered
options.C: 1 either air or water; 2 leaving uncovered
